formation.locator: no formation date on the fetched pages
formation.note: No fetched source states a collaboration formation date; the proposal of 26 January 1982 was submitted by the GSI-LBL-Heidelberg-Marburg-Warsaw Collaboration.

intervals.label: collaboration: proposal to the PS committee
intervals.note: The proposal (16O beams of 9-13A GeV at the PS) was submitted on 26 January 1982. The interval ends on the Greybook approval date (3 February 1983); CERN later moved the ion beams from the PS to the SPS.
intervals.quote: The origins of the NA35 experiment at CERN can be traced back to a proposal [1] submitted by the GSI–LBL–Heidelberg–Marburg–Warsaw Collaboration to CERN’s Proton Synchrotron and Synchro-Cyclotron Committee on January 26, 1982.

intervals.label: collaboration: approval
intervals.locator: Greybook record for NA35 (JSON, experiment details)
intervals.note: Approval date as recorded in Greybook (the original PS proposal). Specht (2014 slides) lists NA35 among the first-generation SPS experiments approved in 11/1984 and the Greybook status history has a row with approvalDate 15-11-1984: the SPS re-approval. The interval ends when the first oxygen beams reached the SPS (autumn 1986) and NA35 began recording data.

intervals.label: collaboration: data taking (light-ion beams at 60A and 200A GeV)
intervals.note: Year precision. Both reviews give the data-taking period 1986-1992.
intervals.quote: NA35 recorded data on collisions of p, d, 16 O, and 32 S beams at 60A GeV/c and 200A GeV/c with S, Ag, and Au targets from 1986 to 1992.

intervals.label: collaboration: completed
intervals.note: Year precision: NA35 data taking ended in 1992; its detector concept was succeeded by NA49 (TPCs replaced the streamer chamber in 1994).
intervals.quote: NA35 was planned from 1981 onwards, and took SPS data from 1986 to 1992.

summary.plain: The collaboration that ran the NA35 streamer-chamber experiment at the CERN SPS; it grew out of the GSI-LBL-Heidelberg-Marburg-Warsaw proposal and later initiated NA49.
summary.technical: NA35 Collaboration (initiator Reinhard Stock; spokesperson later Peter Seyboth per arXiv:2603.10835); formation date and membership not recorded.
